UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Root user profile document for an authenticated Irodori Bunpou learner, including RBAC role for real-time monitoring.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Optional learner display name shown in the header, account menu, and admin monitoring dashboard.

avatarUrl.description: Optional avatar URL (HTTPS or compressed JPEG/PNG/WebP data URI).

email.description: Lowercase verified email address matching the user's Auth token (visible only to owner and admin/superadmin).

role.description: RBAC role: user (learner), admin (read-only real-time monitoring), or superadmin (full monitoring + grant/revoke admin).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile or role update.

BunpouBookProgress.title: BunpouBookProgress
BunpouBookProgress.description: Per-book mastered and hard Irodori Bunpou pattern IDs synced for a learner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

bookId.description: Irodori book identifier matching the document ID.

mastered.description: Unique list of mastered Bunpou pattern IDs belonging to bookId (disjoint from hard).

hard.description: Unique list of hard/review Bunpou pattern IDs belonging to bookId (disjoint from mastered).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this book progress record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest progress sync.

BunpouQuizHistory.title: BunpouQuizHistory
BunpouQuizHistory.description: Per-book compact quiz performance history (up to 15 latest sessions) stored as pure ASCII reference tokens.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

bookId.description: Irodori book identifier matching the document ID.

sessions.description: Up to 15 compact pure-ASCII quiz session reference tokens (<= 16000 chars each, supporting 4-segment legacy items and optional 5th Base64URL chosen-answer segment <= 260 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this quiz history bucket was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest quiz history sync.

LiveActivity.title: LiveActivity
LiveActivity.description: Real-time per-user learner presence, current activity, live quiz status, and aggregate progress snapshot for Admin/Superadmin monitoring.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Lowercase verified email matching the learner's Auth token.

avatarUrl.description: Optional avatar URL (HTTPS or compressed JPEG/PNG/WebP data URI).

activitySummary.description: Concise Bahasa Indonesia description of what the user is doing right now.

quizLiveCurrent.description: Current question number during an active quiz session (0 if idle).

quizLiveTotal.description: Total questions in the active quiz session (0 if idle).

quizLiveCorrect.description: Correct answers count so far during an active quiz session (0 if idle).

masteredTotal.description: Total mastered patterns across all 3 Irodori books.

hardTotal.description: Total hard patterns across all 3 Irodori books.

introMastered.description: Mastered pattern count in Irodori Pemula.

elem1Mastered.description: Mastered pattern count in Irodori Dasar 1.

elem2Mastered.description: Mastered pattern count in Irodori Dasar 2.

latestQuizScore.description: Percentage score (0-100) of the most recent completed quiz, or -1 if none.

latestQuizSummary.description: Short summary of the user's latest completed quiz result.

quizSessionCount.description: Total recorded quiz sessions across all 3 books.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when live activity tracking started for this user.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest activity heartbeat or action.

ActivityEvent.title: ActivityEvent
ActivityEvent.description: Immutable chronological learning event (quiz started, quiz completed, progress update) visible in real time to Admins and Superadmins.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the learner who triggered the event.

displayName.description: Learner display name at the time of the event.

email.description: Lowercase verified email matching the learner's Auth token.

eventType.description: Category of the recorded learning event.

bookId.description: Irodori book associated with the event.

scopeLabel.description: Chapter scope label for the event.

focus.description: Quiz focus mode or none for non-quiz events.

correct.description: Correct answer count (0 if not applicable).

score.description: Percentage score (0-100), or -1 if not a scored completion event.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the event was logged.

/users/{userId}.description: Root profile document for each authenticated learner including RBAC role (Master Gate parent for all subcollections).

/users/{userId}/bunpouProgress/{bookId}.description: Per-book mastered and hard Bunpou pattern progress (introductory, elementary1, elementary2).

/users/{userId}/quizHistory/{bookId}.description: Per-book compact quiz session history tokens (introductory, elementary1, elementary2).

/liveActivity/{userId}.description: Real-time learner status, active quiz progress, and aggregate mastery snapshot for Admin/Superadmin monitoring.

/activityEvents/{eventId}.description: Immutable append-only live activity stream of quiz starts, quiz completions, and milestones.
